meta.name: Meta Lead Ads
meta.tagline: Facebook and Instagram lead ads arrive as enquiries in real time.
meta.description: Log in with Facebook in a popup, pick your Page and every Instant Form lead becomes an enquiry with its campaign, ad set and ad. Leads you already have come in with one click.
meta.getStarted: Leads from your Facebook and Instagram ads
features: One-click Facebook login in a popup, no copy-pasting
All your Pages listed, including Business Manager Pages
Auto Sync every form, or choose forms one by one
Sync leads from the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days
Campaign, ad set, ad and form saved on each enquiry
steps: Click Connect. Facebook opens in a small popup.
Log in, choose “Opt in to all current and future Pages” and click Continue.
Back in the LMS, pick the Page that runs your lead ads.
Keep Auto Sync on for all forms, or turn it off and choose forms.
Click Sync leads to bring in leads you already have.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.tagline: Connect a new number or your WhatsApp Business app number, guided by Facebook.
whatsapp.description: Connect the same way as Make.com: a Facebook popup guides you to choose or create your WhatsApp Business Account, then add a new phone number (verified by SMS or call) or keep using your WhatsApp Business app number (coexistence). The LMS subscribes to the account and registers new numbers for you.
features: Guided Facebook popup, no API keys
Add a new number, or use your WhatsApp Business app number
New numbers registered automatically (two-step PIN saved)
Choose which number the team uses
steps: Choose Connect a number or Connect the app number.
In the Facebook popup, choose or create your business and WhatsApp Business Account.
Add your phone number and verify it (or confirm your WhatsApp Business app number).
Back in the LMS, the number is listed under WhatsApp numbers.

exotel.name: Exotel
exotel.tagline: Cloud calling with automatic calls to new leads and at scheduled times.
exotel.description: Connect your Exotel account with its API key and token. The LMS loads your ExoPhones (virtual numbers) and can call automatically: Exotel rings the agent first, then connects the lead, showing your chosen ExoPhone.
exotel.connectHint: Paste the details from Exotel › Settings › API Settings.
features: All active ExoPhones listed, refreshed automatically once a day
Auto-call new leads from the forms you choose, after 1, 2 or 5 minutes
Auto-call at the time of a scheduled call (can be switched off per call)
Every auto-call is logged on the enquiry
steps: Log in to Exotel and open Settings › API Settings.
Copy the Account SID, API key and API token, and check your region (Mumbai or Singapore).
Click Connect and paste the details. The LMS checks them with Exotel and loads your numbers.
Choose the default caller number and turn on auto-calling where you want it.
Make sure every agent has their phone number under Users.

google_sheets.name: Google Sheets
google_sheets.tagline: Send leads to a Google Sheet (kept up to date) or import a sheet's rows as leads.
google_sheets.description: Log in with Google. Connect a Meta form (for example your real estate form) to a sheet: all its leads are written there and the sheet stays up to date as leads arrive and their status and details change. You can also import a sheet's rows as enquiries.
features: One-click Google login in a popup
Send a form's leads (or all enquiries) to a new spreadsheet or a new tab
Status, owner and other changes update the sheet about every minute
Import rows of a sheet as enquiries; new rows synced every 5 minutes
steps: Click Connect with Google and allow read-only access to your sheets.
Pick the spreadsheet and the tab with your leads (the first row holds the column names).
Check the name, phone and email columns, then click Connect sheet.
